decisions.decision: Migrations as an ordered SQL list in schema.py, tracked in ccctx_migrations, version row written after its statements succeed, ORA-00955 ignored
decisions.why: Oracle DDL auto-commits; this makes a half-applied migration re-runnable with no new dependency or package data
decisions.rejected: Alembic/Liquibase, .sql files under db/migrations, container startup scripts

decisions.decision: repo add, repo list and list_repositories call migrate first; ccctx db migrate also exists
decisions.why: fresh database works without an extra step; check is one select once applied
decisions.rejected: explicit migrate only (first repo add fails with ORA-00942)

decisions.decision: registry.py is the shared core; cli.py and server.py are thin wrappers
decisions.why: constitution III: CLI and MCP must call the same core library
decisions.rejected: logic in cli.py with the tool shelling out

decisions.decision: Symbols reach repository, path and language through ccctx_files; cascade deletes via FKs
decisions.why: one place for each fact; FR-009 enforced by the database
decisions.rejected: denormalized repo_id/path/language on symbols (add when search needs it)

decisions.decision: Exit codes 0 ok, 1 refused input or config, 2 unreachable or still starting; no waiting
decisions.why: matches golestan-check-db and keeps the 5 s failure bound
decisions.rejected: per-refusal codes; retrying while the DB starts

decisions.decision: Store Path.expanduser().resolve() string; unique on it
decisions.why: removes .., symlinks and, on Windows, normalizes casing to the real path

decisions.decision: One RegistryError carrying the user-facing message instead of a subclass per refusal
decisions.why: callers only print it; tests match on message

decisions.decision: CLI validates name and path before connecting
decisions.why: bad input is reported without a database, and fast
decisions.rejected: letting add_repo do it after connect

decisions.decision: db migrate skips the automatic pre-migrate
decisions.why: otherwise it always reported 'up to date'
